name: Mercury Layouts
description: Provides composable layouts for the Mercury Editor page-building experience.
project_description:
This module provides a set of composable layouts intended for, but not exclusive to, the Mercury Editor module. 

 The included layouts are created using the Single Directory Components (sdc) module which means the underlying components can be used in any Twig template regardless of your theme or module. They are not limited to modules using layout discovery such as Layout Builder or Layout Paragraphs.

 These layouts are based concepts described in Every Layout , a fantastic learning resource for creating accessible layouts using modern CSS. If you are not familiar with the concepts described in Every Layout, it's highly recommend you take the time to read it to gain a better understanding of some the configuration options available in these layouts.

 Requirements 
 
 Layout Discovery 
 Single Directory Components (sdc) (Drupal Core < 10.3 only) 
 Style Options
